results.body:
new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withMethod("GET")
                .withPath("/o-json-schema")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("accept", "text/event-stream"),
                        new Header("host", "localhost:<port>")
                )
                .withSecure(false)
                .withKeepAlive(true)
                .withProtocol(Protocol.HTTP_1_1),
        Times.once(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.respond(
        response()
                .withStatusCode(200)
                .withReasonPhrase("OK")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("Content-Type", "application/json"),
                        new Header("x-mockserver-response-time-ms", "<ms>")
                )
                .withBody("{\"a\": 1, \"b\": \"two\"}")
                .withGenerateFromSchema("{\"type\": \"object\", \"properties\": {\"id\": {\"type\": \"integer\", \"minimum\": 7, \"maximum\": 7}}, \"required\": [\"id\"]}")
);
